results.title: From Enugu to the world: How Hackathon Africa 3.0 is building tomorrows tech leaders
results.description: When 20 young Nigerians walked into the Hackathon Africa Innovation Hub in Enugu on July 17, they were not merely reporting for another training programme. They were taking their first steps into a four-month journey that could redefine their futures and position them for opportunities in the global technology ecosystem.The post From Enugu to the world: How Hackathon Africa 3.0 is building tomorrows tech leaders appeared first on The Sun Nigeria.
